question.prompt: John is walking east at a speed of \(3\) miles per hour, while Bob is also walking east, but at a speed of \(5\) miles per hour. If Bob is now \(1\) mile west of John, how many minutes will it take for Bob to catch up to John?

solutions.explanation:
Bob starts behind John, and both walk east. Bob therefore gains on John at a rate of
\[
5-3=2\text{ miles per hour}.
\]
At that rate, closing the \(1\)-mile gap takes
\[
\frac{1}{2}\text{ hour}=30\text{ minutes}.
\]
Thus Bob catches John after \(30\) minutes, choice A.
solutions.title: Find how quickly the gap closes
